name: Acceptance Desire
description: Just wants someone to say you're enough, exactly as you are
behavioral_signature: Shapes behavior around gaining unconditional acceptance
under_stress: Becomes invisible, removing anything that might provoke rejection
at_rest: Quietly hoping to be seen and accepted without conditions
will_always: seek validation from those they respect
will_never: risk being rejected for who they really are
unless: hiding becomes more painful than the risk of being seen
